findings.evidence: The no-source fallback repeats the instructions at line 12 to verify supplied facts, label the handoff unverified, and mark unknowns.
findings.fix: Consolidate the duplicated fallback into the first no-source branch and retain a short cross-reference at line 24; preserve all safeguards.

findings.evidence: “An error message string is not a stable discriminator. Branch on a serialized code or field” treats all message strings as unstable even if a contract explicitly guarantees one.
findings.fix: Warn against assuming message stability; prefer a documented machine-readable code and, if none exists, describe any explicitly guaranteed discriminator or state that no stable discriminator is known.

findings.evidence: The four output cases exercise supplied contracts, unknowns, and source tracing, but none exercises an update when versioned handoff files already exist.
findings.fix: Add a fixture with api-handoff.md and existing versioned siblings, and assert that an update preserves existing versions and selects the next appropriate destination.

findings.evidence: “write `api-handoff-v2.md` (and so on) only when a versioned sibling already exists” does not specify how to choose a new name when v2 or later files already exist.
findings.fix: Inspect existing sibling versions, choose the next unused suffix according to the repository's convention, and never overwrite a prior version unless the user explicitly requests it.
